# KTOO

> KTOO is Alaska's public media news and radio station from Juneau, providing local journalism, community storytelling, and live legislative coverage.

KTOO serves as Juneau's primary source for public radio programming, news, and podcasts. The station emphasizes community voices, local history preservation, and coverage of Alaska state government and energy policy.

## Key Topics

- Juneau local news
- Alaska public media
- Public radio
- Alaska Legislature
- Podcasts
- Community journalism
- Filipino-American history
- Alaska energy policy
- Gavel Alaska
- Juneau Afternoon
- Oral history
- State government
- Mendenhall Valley
- Cultural storytelling
- Municipal elections

## News & Coverage

- [KTOO - News & Public Media from Alaska's Capital](https://www.ktoo.org): KTOO homepage: Alaska public media news and programming from Juneau
- [2025 Juneau Municipal Election](https://www.ktoo.org/elections): 2025 Juneau municipal election coverage with candidate guides and voting info
- [Alaska's Energy Desk](https://www.ktoo.org/alaskasenergydesk): Collaborative journalism covering Alaska energy policy and environmental issues

## Radio Programs & Podcasts

- [Juneau Afternoon](https://www.ktoo.org/juneau-afternoon): Juneau Afternoon radio show featuring community interviews and local news
- [Podcasts Directory](https://www.ktoo.org/podcasts): KTOO podcast directory featuring local news and cultural storytelling programs
- [Curious Juneau](https://www.ktoo.org/curiousjuneau): Curious Juneau podcast exploring local history and community questions
- [Gardentalk](https://www.ktoo.org/programs/gardentalk): Gardentalk podcast providing Juneau gardening tips and seasonal advice
- [Culture Rich Conversations](https://www.ktoo.org/juneau-afternoon/culture-rich-conversations): Culture Rich Conversations podcast series on social justice and Black awareness

## Legislative & Government Coverage

- [Gavel Alaska](https://www.ktoo.org/gavel): Gavel Alaska live-streams Alaska Legislature and Supreme Court proceedings
- [Gavel Alaska Schedule](https://www.ktoo.org/gavel/schedule): Gavel Alaska broadcast schedule for legislative and court proceedings

## Community & Cultural History

- [Mga Kuwento](https://www.ktoo.org/mgakuwento): Mga Kuwento oral history project preserving Filipino community stories in Juneau
- [Filipinos in Alaska](https://www.ktoo.org/filipinos-in-alaska): Oral history archive documenting Filipino community heritage in Alaska
